question: Rank the customer regions by revenue (price times quantity) and tell me which one is first.

sql: SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'customers' ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name

SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'customers' ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status <> 'returned'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT c.region, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY sales DESC
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'customers' ORDER BY ordinal_position

answer: The South region had the highest sales, at 1,201,250 (sum of unit price × quantity across all orders, with region taken from the customer who placed each order). West was next at 1,173,750, followed by North at 1,162,500 and East at 1,160,000.

answer:
The South region generated the most revenue, at 1,201,250.00 (sum of product price × quantity across all order items, with no status filter). West was second at 1,173,750.00, North third at 1,162,500.00, and East fourth at 1,160,000.00.

If returned orders are excluded, South still leads at 1,201,250.00, followed by West at 1,173,750.00 and East at 1,160,000.00. North drops out of that result entirely, which suggests all of its revenue comes from returned orders.
